name: Chart Maker
summary: Paste cells from Excel or Sheets, or load a CSV, then style a bar, line, pie or donut chart with an animated preview and add it to your Draft as an editable graphic. Optional AI design from reference images.

compatibility.selects: Requires Panel SDK runScript, storage and confirm, plus Draft addMotionGraphic. AI design uses askAI with aiProviders (Selects credits or the chat model). Desktop only. Windows GUI validation pending.

de.name: Diagramm-Maker
de.summary: Mache aus eingefügten Tabellenzellen oder einer CSV-Datei ein bearbeitbares Balken-, Linien-, Kreis- oder Ringdiagramm mit Animation und füge es deinem Entwurf hinzu.

en.name: Chart Maker
en.summary: Paste cells from Excel or Sheets, or load a CSV, then style a bar, line, pie or donut chart with an animated preview and add it to your Draft as an editable graphic. Optional AI design from reference images.

es.name: Creador de gráficos
es.summary: Pega celdas de Excel o Sheets, o carga un CSV, y crea un gráfico de barras, líneas, circular o de anillo animado y editable en tu borrador.

fr.name: Créateur de graphiques
fr.summary: Collez des cellules d'Excel ou de Sheets, ou chargez un CSV, puis créez un graphique animé et modifiable (barres, courbes, secteurs ou anneau) dans votre brouillon.

it.name: Crea grafici
it.summary: Incolla celle da Excel o Sheets, o carica un CSV, e crea nella bozza un grafico animato e modificabile a barre, linee, torta o ciambella.

ja.name: チャートメーカー
ja.summary: Excelやスプレッドシートのセルを貼り付けるかCSVを読み込み、棒・折れ線・円・ドーナツグラフをアニメーション付きの編集可能なグラフィックとしてドラフトに追加します。

ko.name: 차트 메이커
ko.summary: 엑셀이나 시트에서 복사한 셀을 붙여 넣거나 CSV를 불러와 막대, 선, 원, 도넛 차트를 만들고, 애니메이션이 들어간 편집 가능한 그래픽으로 드래프트에 추가합니다.

pt.name: Criador de gráficos
pt.summary: Cole células do Excel ou do Sheets, ou carregue um CSV, e crie no seu rascunho um gráfico animado e editável de barras, linhas, pizza ou rosca.

tr.name: Grafik Oluşturucu
tr.summary: Excel veya Sheets hücrelerini yapıştırın ya da bir CSV yükleyin; çubuk, çizgi, pasta veya halka grafiğini animasyonlu ve düzenlenebilir olarak taslağınıza ekleyin.

zh.name: 图表制作器
zh.summary: 粘贴 Excel 或表格中的单元格，或载入 CSV，制作带动画的可编辑柱状图、折线图、饼图或环形图，并添加到草稿中。
